description: This file contains the utility class `Exec` which provides methods to execute system commands, stream outputs, handle timeouts, and report execution status within an Android environment.

classes.name: Exec
classes.description: Utility class to execute shell commands and handle process streams, timeouts, and exceptions.

methods.name: runForStream
methods.description: Executes a command line in a subprocess, returning the process's InputStream while handling timeout and cancellation callbacks.

methods.name: runForStrings
methods.description: Executes a command line, collects output lines into a String array, and manages timeout and cancellation callbacks.
